notes: Diagnostic adequate, not independent finance-expert validation. The reported numbers and main operating-versus-net divergence are correct. The answer briefly infers 'gathering' assets from AUM endpoints, although its later uncertainty section correctly says those endpoints cannot establish flows; and it says operating improvement cannot be separated from expense growth although the selected rows arithmetically bridge +1,086 revenue minus +862 expense to +224 operating income. It also discusses increased sponsored-product NCI without naming the event-only 70 USD-million Subco Units allocation; consolidated income declines 138 while parent-attributable income declines 270, so the full parent bridge needs both NCI changes (+62 sponsored products and event-only 70 Subco Units). These are noncritical weaknesses given the bounded hold, but keep I/R/U below high.
